en: The image shows an old-fashioned, sepia-toned view of a street with a wooden house and a wooden fence in the foreground. In the background, there is a prominent round water tower (with a lookout section at the top) rising above the trees. There is also a church spire visible further in the background. The scene has a distinctly northern European architectural style. The bottom of the postcard displays the words 'Hangö Vattentornet' and 'Hanko Vesitorni', which are Swedish and Finnish respectively.
